messages:
emma: Heads up — auditor requested a consolidated export for recent RBAC changes + KMS key usage (timeline + artifacts). Need one zip and a short handoff note with query examples. @raj @sam can you own? cc @olivia

raj: On it. Which controls exactly? The auditor mentioned access management + cryptographic key lifecycle but want to be precise.

lydia (auditor): hi team — exact ask: 1) timeline of role/grant changes since 2025-10-01, 2) KMS key create/rotate/disable events, 3) vuln tickets referencing keys, 4) incident timeline for any access anomalies. Prefer CSV or parquet, plus a short mapping doc.

sam: We can export CloudTrail + internal iam_audit table + KMS metadata. I'll run an export to s3://redwood-audit/evidence/2026-03-22/roles_kms_export_1719001234.zip — will add a README with verification steps.

raj: Plan: 1) RBAC change query from postgres audit table:
```
SELECT * FROM iam_audit
WHERE action IN ('add_role','grant_role','revoke_role','remove_role')
AND ts >= '2025-10-01'
ORDER BY ts;
```
2) CloudTrail filter for KMS events: EventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" AND EventName IN ("CreateKey","ScheduleKeyDeletion","DisableKey","EnableKeyRotation","ReEncrypt");
3) Join on resource ARNs and cross-ref to jira ticket IDs found in PRs.

devops-bot: Export job started: export-id=exp-6721, ETA ~12m. Intermediate files at s3://redwood-audit/tmp/exp-6721/ 

olivia: Also include PR links and approval traces (GitHub review comments). Create a one-pager mapping each artifact to SOC 2 / ISO controls (example rows).

raj: Example control mapping snippet I'll include in control_mapping.md: 
"SOC2-CC6.2" -> iam_audit.table: policy_change, PR #4502, approver=@olivia, timestamp=2026-01-12T15:23:45Z
"ISO-A.9.2" -> KMS key rotation evidence: kms_describe.json + cloudtrail events

lydia (auditor): Can you also provide proof of key custody? We need key policy snapshots, aliases, ARNs, and rotation status for each CMK in scope.

sam: We have a script to snapshot KMS metadata; example commands I'll include in README: 
```
aws kms describe-key --key-id <key-id> --region us-west-2 > describe-<key-id>.json
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id> > rotation-<key-id>.json
aws kms list-resource-tags --key-id <key-id> > tags-<key-id>.json
```
I will attach the outputs.

raj: For vuln triage, query JIRA: project = INF AND labels in (kms, crypto, key) AND created >= '2025-10-01' ORDER BY created ASC; link any INF ticket IDs into the export.

olivia: Triage notes: one vuln (INF-3245) from 2026-01-18 marked low for alias exposure, fixed via PR #4599. Include timeline: detection -> triage -> PR -> deploy -> verification.

emma: :thumbsup: After export, can someone draft the handoff note with quick verification steps for the auditor (checksum, sample query to reproduce counts, how to find control mapping)?

sam: I'll add a verification snippet to README: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/evidence/2026-03-22/exp-6721-export.zip ./exp.zip
sha256sum exp.zip
unzip -l exp.zip
csvsql --query "SELECT count(*) FROM iam_audit WHERE ts >= '2025-10-01'" iam_audit.csv
```

devops-bot: Export completed: export-id=exp-6721, s3://redwood-audit/evidence/2026-03-22/exp-6721-export.zip, size=24MB 

lydia (auditor): Thanks — two follow-ups: 1) retention on these artifacts? 2) chain-of-custody: who had write/read during export (need CloudTrail/S3 access logs)? Also would like a signed attestation paragraph.

raj: Retention: evidence bucket lifecycle = 365d for ad-hoc exports (policy). Chain-of-custody: CloudTrail shows PutObject by role=ci-runner, PutObjectAcl by sam, and subsequent reads by auditor role. I'll export S3 access logs + CloudTrail events and include a CSV of access events (PutObject/GetObject).

olivia: I'll draft the attestation paragraph and sign it once logs verify identities. Sample attestation: "We confirm the enclosed artifacts were exported from Redwood production systems on 2026-03-22 by authorized staff and systems; lifecycle retention is 365 days."

emma: Great — once we have logs + control_mapping.md + README + export zip, I'll upload final handoff to auditor folder. Thanks all.

sam: Done — final handoff uploaded: s3://redwood-audit/auditor-lydia/1719001234-handoff.zip (contains export zip, control_mapping.md, README_verification.txt, kms_snapshots/ , jira_references.csv)

lydia (auditor): Received. I'll validate and flag any gaps. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :pray:
